name: Org — Registro, Onboarding y CRUD de Inventario

planSteps.description: Fill out 'Nombre' with 'TestSprite QA Org', 'Correo electrónico' with a random email ending in '@testsprite.test', and 'Contraseña' with 'Test1234!', then submit the form.
Click on the 'Soy una fundación' card
Fill out the organization onboarding form: Name 'TestSprite QA -- ignorar', Phone '3001234567', City 'Bogotá'. Submit the form.
Click the button to add a new item. Fill name 'Item de Prueba [TEST]', quantity '10', unit 'unidades', Category 'alimentos', and save.
Verify 'Item de Prueba [TEST]' appears in the inventory list
Click the edit button for 'Item de Prueba [TEST]', change the quantity to '20', and save.
Verify the item quantity is now 20 in the list
Click the delete button for 'Item de Prueba [TEST]' and confirm the deletion.
Verify 'Item de Prueba [TEST]' no longer appears in the inventory list
